text:
Michael Misa is 19, the second pick in the 2025 draft, and already learning the league's business side. Detroit's Simon Edvinsson, an unsigned restricted free agent, wants out, the Red Wings reportedly want a young center back with Dylan Larkin holding out for a trade, and the Sharks have been linked to him. San Jose Hockey Now's headline on Nov. 15: "Misa Aware of Edvinsson Trade Rumors."

On the ice, his ice time is up to 16.9 minutes over his last ten games, and he has 11 points in 23 games, 3 on the power play. His finishing is right where it should be, 4 goals on 4.87 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, and his count of 20 mph bursts ranks in the 94th percentile in NHL EDGE tracking.

The hard part is 5-on-5, where San Jose has taken just 37.9% of expected goals with him on the ice, 7.8 points worse than without him. Forwards picked in the top four since 2005 scored a median 0.56 points a game in their first full season, and every one with four-plus seasons reached 200 games. He is finding his level in public.
headline: Misa is growing up with his name in trade talk
